explication: gawkbot is a local-first AI office that turns a user’s workflow into supervised bots, microapps, routines, tools, knowledge, and integrations. The principal flow is: user submits a workflow, the broker onboards and plans it, scheduled bot execution invokes the agent sidecar, models and tools operate over workspace context, and writes pause at approval before producing office-visible results. The graph preserves documented capabilities; several web/API connections are inferred only at subsystem level because their implementations were not sampled.
